left_character_action: stands alone near the snack table holding one red plastic cup
left_setting: a small minimalist indoor party room
left_emotion: Nervous, awkward, and unsure where to stand—never happy.
right_character_actions: stand close together, each holding one red plastic cup, laughing and dancing while looking at each other
right_setting: the same small minimalist indoor party room
right_emotion: Lively, playful, and warm because they are together.
shared_environment: Same small indoor party room with one snack table, balloons, the same floor, and the same camera view.
environmental_contrast: Left has deflated balloons, sparse snacks, and stillness. Right has floating balloons, fuller snacks, confetti, and movement.
execution_risks: No crowds or extra characters
Keep cups correctly scaled and do not create fingers
Keep the snack table secondary and both characters on the floor
notes: Canonical scene-depth example: designed, readable, and lively without becoming crowded.

left_character_action: lies alone across one couch seat holding a remote

right_character_actions: cuddle together on the same couch while watching the same movie
right_setting: the same simple living room facing the same small television
right_emotion: Loving and excited by the shared comfort.
shared_environment: Same living room, couch, television position, floor, and camera angle.

Do not obscure the bow, ponytail, or two hair tufts
Keep snack bowls smaller than either face
notes: Comfort comes from proximity, not from a more luxurious room.
